audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: Ornn wins 55.46 percent of 851 games, yet the chart gives Cassiopeia six of seven stages and Ornn none. The full and content layers agree with each other and every why supports the row it sits on, so no single row can be flipped on evidence.
audit.why: Cassiopeia genuinely wins the lane phase — Miasma grounds Searing Charge, Twin Fang out-DPSes Ornn's trades — but a chart with zero Ornn rows cannot explain a 55 percent win rate, and the 2+ items row in particular sits against Ornn's Masterwork scaling.
audit.corrected: Not corrected. Flipping rows here would be a guess; recorded as a question instead. The diff/diffRating mismatch below is part of the same call.

audit.why: Spike text already carries the right stages: her Twin Fang ramp, Ornn's level 6 and first item, her 2-item AP window. The mirror pass wrote the real cooldowns into the Cassiopeia-side entry and they match this kit read (Volcanic Rupture 9s, Searing Charge 14s, Miasma 24s, Petrifying Gaze 120s).
audit.corrected: No change needed; the cooldown numbers are now written into this side's cooldown block too.

audit.whatIsWrong: Petrifying Gaze's facing requirement was never stated — the page calls it a 'face-stun' in one line of prose but never tells the player what to do about it. Twin Fang's healing was absent, and no cooldown numbers appeared anywhere in the cooldown block.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her; enemies with their back turned are slowed instead. That is a decision the player can act on mid-fight. Twin Fang heals for a percentage of the damage dealt and is on a 0.75s cooldown, so it is the anti-heal target. Miasma is 24s at rank 1, which is the actual engage window.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now gives Miasma's 24s, Petrifying Gaze's 120s and the turn-away rule, and names Twin Fang as the anti-heal target; dosFull[0].d and the dontsFull bodies carry the numbers.
